purpose: Apply the unchanged velocity-blind THINGS moment-0 and SINGS registration to the two final holdout galaxies without opening moment-1, moment-2, or SPARC velocity targets.
permittedInputs: THINGS natural-weighted moment 0 image and FITS header for the two holdout systems
SINGS IRAC channel-1 image, weight image, and FITS headers for the two holdout systems
SPARC sky coordinate, distance, inclination, H I mass, 3.6 micron luminosity, effective radius, and Hubble type
forbiddenInputs: SPARC observed rotation speeds or errors
any gravity-formula prediction, score, or parameter

processing.method: Bit-for-bit P0739 registration implementation generalized only to the holdout split named here.
processing.positionAngle: robust SINGS second moments inside five effective radii
processing.foregroundSuppression: 12 robust-MAD compact residual rule with central 0.2-effective-radius protection
processing.extent: 1.20 times max(H I R995, six effective radii)

claimBoundary: P0751A is a final-holdout observational registration test, not a gravity score.
Its implementation, inputs, and gates are committed before either holdout image or velocity array is opened.
A SINGS-footprint failure remains visible because the separately preregistered WISE fusion is the only permitted repair.
No velocity or dispersion target may be opened in this stage.
